SELECT
    date_trunc('minute', created_at) AS time, -- Groups into 1-minute blocks
    MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE measurement = 'NO2')      AS no2,
    MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE measurement = 'P10R')     AS p10r,
    MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE measurement = 'P25R')     AS p25r,
    MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE measurement = 'PM10')     AS pm10,
    MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE measurement = 'PM25')     AS pm25,
    MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE measurement = 'VOC')      AS voc
FROM aqsensors_aqlog 
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)  
GROUP BY time  -- PostgreSQL natively allows grouping by SELECT aliases if no math is applied
ORDER BY time;

select name || '-Ikea' Device,battery_pct Percentage ,last_seen_at as last from ikea_devices 

UNION ALL

select name || '-Ring',battery_life as Percentage,last_motion_at as last from ring_devices 
order by Percentage

SELECT
    date_trunc('minute', combined.created_at) AS time, -- Groups into 1-minute blocks
    MAX(CASE WHEN combined.pretty_name = 'Master Bedroom' THEN (combined.primary_value * 9/5) + 32 END) AS "Master Bedroom",
    MAX(CASE WHEN combined.pretty_name = 'Gdn Clone'      THEN (combined.primary_value * 9/5) + 32 END) AS "Gdn Clone",
    MAX(CASE WHEN combined.pretty_name = 'Out SEbS 142°'  THEN (combined.primary_value * 9/5) + 32 END) AS "Out SEbS 142°",
    MAX(CASE WHEN combined.pretty_name = 'Gdn Near Res.'  THEN (combined.primary_value * 9/5) + 32 END) AS "Gdn Near Res.",
    MAX(CASE WHEN combined.pretty_name = 'Garage'         THEN (combined.primary_value * 9/5) + 32 END) AS "Garage",
    MAX(CASE WHEN combined.pretty_name = 'Main Attic'     THEN (combined.primary_value * 9/5) + 32 END) AS "Main Attic",
    MAX(CASE WHEN combined.pretty_name = 'Garage Attic'   THEN (combined.primary_value * 9/5) + 32 END) AS "Garage Attic",
    MAX(CASE WHEN combined.pretty_name = 'Jessica''s'     THEN (combined.primary_value * 9/5) + 32 END) AS "Jessica's",
    MAX(CASE WHEN combined.pretty_name = 'Gdn Veg'        THEN (combined.primary_value * 9/5) + 32 END) AS "Gdn Veg",
    MAX(CASE WHEN combined.pretty_name = 'Gdn Flower'     THEN (combined.primary_value * 9/5) + 32 END) AS "Gdn Flower",
    MAX(CASE WHEN combined.pretty_name = 'Kitchen'        THEN (combined.primary_value * 9/5) + 32 END) AS "Kitchen",
    MAX(CASE WHEN combined.pretty_name = 'Gdn Vent'       THEN (combined.primary_value * 9/5) + 32 END) AS "Gdn Vent",
    MAX(CASE WHEN combined.pretty_name = 'Clone'          THEN combined.primary_value END) AS "Clone",
    MAX(CASE WHEN combined.pretty_name = 'Veg'            THEN combined.primary_value END) AS "Veg",
    MAX(CASE WHEN combined.pretty_name = 'Flower'         THEN combined.primary_value END) AS "Flower",
    MAX(CASE WHEN combined.pretty_name = 'Office'         THEN combined.primary_value END) AS "Office",
    MAX(CASE WHEN combined.pretty_name = 'Outside Station'THEN combined.primary_value END) AS "Outside Station",
    MAX(CASE WHEN combined.pretty_name = 'Laundry Room'   THEN combined.primary_value END) AS "Laundry Room",
    MAX(CASE WHEN combined.pretty_name = 'Acurite-Tower 5715'  THEN combined.primary_value END) AS "Acurite-Tower 5715",
    MAX(CASE WHEN combined.pretty_name = 'Acurite-Tower 10196' THEN combined.primary_value END) AS "Acurite-Tower 10196"
FROM (
    -- Subquery 1: Thermometers
    SELECT b.created_at, a.pretty_name, b.primary_value
    FROM tstats_thermometer a
    JOIN tstats_tstatlog b ON a.romid = b.romid_id
    WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
    UNION ALL

    -- Subquery 2: Thermohygrometers
    SELECT b.created_at, a.pretty_name, b.temp_f AS primary_value
    FROM tstats_thermohygrometer a
    JOIN tstats_thermohygrostatlog b ON b.thermohygrometer_id = a.id_channel
    WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
) AS combined
GROUP BY date_trunc('minute', combined.created_at)
ORDER BY time;

SELECT
    l.recorded_at AS time,
    l.speed_mph,
    l.direction_deg
FROM anemometer_logs l
JOIN anemometers a ON a.external_id = l.anemometer_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(l.recorded_at)
ORDER BY time;

SELECT
    l.recorded_at AS time,
    l.lumens,
    l.uv_index
FROM photo_uvmeter_logs l
JOIN photo_uvmeters a ON a.external_id = l.photo_uvmeter_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(l.recorded_at)
ORDER BY time;

SELECT
    l.recorded_at AS time,
    l.rain_in
FROM raingauge_logs l
JOIN raingauges a ON a.external_id = l.raingauge_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(l.recorded_at)
ORDER BY time;

SELECT
    date_trunc('minute', l.recorded_at) AS time,
    SUM(l.watts) FILTER (WHERE c.name IN ('Down Furnace 1','Down Furnace 2'))       AS "Down Furnace",
    SUM(l.watts) FILTER (WHERE c.name IN ('Up Furnace 1','Up Furnace 2'))           AS "Up Furnace",
    SUM(l.watts) FILTER (WHERE c.name IN ('Down Comp 1','Down Comp 2'))             AS "Down Comp",
    SUM(l.watts) FILTER (WHERE c.name IN ('Up Comp 1','Up Comp 2'))                 AS "Up Comp",
    SUM(l.watts) FILTER (WHERE c.name IN ('Dryer (ch 7)','Dryer (ch 8)'))           AS "Dryer",
    SUM(l.watts) FILTER (WHERE c.name IN ('Well (ch 9)','Well (ch 10)'))            AS "Well",
    SUM(l.watts) FILTER (WHERE c.name IN ('Water Heater (ch 11)','Water Heater (ch 12)')) AS "Water Heater",
    MAX(l.watts) FILTER (WHERE c.name = 'Back Yard 1/2')                            AS "Back Yard 1/2",
    MAX(l.watts) FILTER (WHERE c.name = 'Front Window')                             AS "Front Window",
    MAX(l.watts) FILTER (WHERE c.name = 'MiCasa Main (unmetered balance)')          AS "MiCasa Main (unmetered balance)",
    MAX(l.watts) FILTER (WHERE c.name = 'MiCasa Main (total)')                      AS "MiCasa Main (total)"
FROM energy_circuit_logs l
JOIN energy_circuits c ON c.id = l.circuit_id
WHERE l.recorded_at BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom() AS timestamptz) AND CAST($__timeTo() AS timestamptz)
  AND c.name NOT LIKE 'TP-LINK_Power Strip%'
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time;

SELECT
    date_trunc('minute', l.recorded_at) AS time,
    MAX(l.watts) FILTER (WHERE c.name = 'TP-LINK_Power Strip_0916')                                        AS "Strip 0916",
    MAX(l.watts) FILTER (WHERE c.name = 'TP-LINK_Power Strip_0916 / Ofc PC')                                AS "Ofc PC",
    MAX(l.watts) FILTER (WHERE c.name = 'TP-LINK_Power Strip_0916 / Ofc Right Plug 1 Empty')                AS "Ofc Right Plug 1 Empty",
    MAX(l.watts) FILTER (WHERE c.name = 'TP-LINK_Power Strip_0916 / Ofc Alexa')                             AS "Ofc Alexa",
    MAX(l.watts) FILTER (WHERE c.name = 'TP-LINK_Power Strip_0916 / Ofc Honeywell-Acurite-Ikea')            AS "Ofc Honeywell-Acurite-Ikea",
    MAX(l.watts) FILTER (WHERE c.name = 'TP-LINK_Power Strip_0916 / Ofc Netgear POE Switch')                AS "Ofc Netgear POE Switch",
    MAX(l.watts) FILTER (WHERE c.name = 'TP-LINK_Power Strip_0916 / Ofc Netgear RAX80 Router')              AS "Ofc Netgear RAX80 Router",
    MAX(l.watts) FILTER (WHERE c.name = 'TP-LINK_Power Strip_47EA')                                         AS "Strip 47EA",
    MAX(l.watts) FILTER (WHERE c.name = 'TP-LINK_Power Strip_47EA / Garden Flower Fan')                     AS "Garden Flower Fan",
    MAX(l.watts) FILTER (WHERE c.name = 'TP-LINK_Power Strip_47EA / Garden Flower Feed')                    AS "Garden Flower Feed",
    MAX(l.watts) FILTER (WHERE c.name = 'TP-LINK_Power Strip_47EA / Garden Flower Lights')                  AS "Garden Flower Lights",
    MAX(l.watts) FILTER (WHERE c.name = 'TP-LINK_Power Strip_47EA / Garden Propagation Heater')             AS "Garden Propagation Heater",
    MAX(l.watts) FILTER (WHERE c.name = 'TP-LINK_Power Strip_47EA / Garden Veg Feed')                       AS "Garden Veg Feed",
    MAX(l.watts) FILTER (WHERE c.name = 'TP-LINK_Power Strip_47EA / Garden Veg Lights')                     AS "Garden Veg Lights",
    MAX(l.watts) FILTER (WHERE c.name = 'TP-LINK_Power Strip_EEF1')                                         AS "Strip EEF1",
    MAX(l.watts) FILTER (WHERE c.name = 'TP-LINK_Power Strip_EEF1 / Ofc Desk Light')                        AS "Ofc Desk Light",
    MAX(l.watts) FILTER (WHERE c.name = 'TP-LINK_Power Strip_EEF1 / Ofc Left 3 Empty')                      AS "Ofc Left 3 Empty",
    MAX(l.watts) FILTER (WHERE c.name = 'TP-LINK_Power Strip_EEF1 / Ofc PC Monitor')                        AS "Ofc PC Monitor",
    MAX(l.watts) FILTER (WHERE c.name = 'TP-LINK_Power Strip_EEF1 / Ofc PC Speakers')                       AS "Ofc PC Speakers",
    MAX(l.watts) FILTER (WHERE c.name = 'TP-LINK_Power Strip_EEF1 / Ofc Printer')                           AS "Ofc Printer",
    MAX(l.watts) FILTER (WHERE c.name = 'TP-LINK_Power Strip_EEF1 / Ofc Uplift Desk')                       AS "Ofc Uplift Desk"
FROM energy_circuit_logs l
JOIN energy_circuits c ON c.id = l.circuit_id
WHERE l.recorded_at BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom() AS timestamptz) AND CAST($__timeTo() AS timestamptz)
  AND c.name LIKE 'TP-LINK_Power Strip%'
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time;

SELECT
    date_trunc('minute', l.recorded_at) AS time,
    MAX(l.disp_temperature) FILTER (WHERE z.name = 'Downstairs') AS "Downstairs Temp",
    MAX(l.heat_setpoint)    FILTER (WHERE z.name = 'Downstairs') AS "Downstairs Heat SP",
    MAX(l.cool_setpoint)    FILTER (WHERE z.name = 'Downstairs') AS "Downstairs Cool SP",
    MAX(l.disp_temperature) FILTER (WHERE z.name = 'Upstairs')   AS "Upstairs Temp",
    MAX(l.heat_setpoint)    FILTER (WHERE z.name = 'Upstairs')   AS "Upstairs Heat SP",
    MAX(l.cool_setpoint)    FILTER (WHERE z.name = 'Upstairs')   AS "Upstairs Cool SP"
FROM hvac_zone_logs l
JOIN hvac_zones z ON z.external_id = l.hvac_zone_id
WHERE l.recorded_at BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom() AS timestamptz) AND CAST($__timeTo() AS timestamptz)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time;
